entries.1f1feb7a259e6609: A service that operates the fresh fish select shop “sakana bacca,” which mainly sells fish species not commonly sold in general supermarkets and seafood with a focus on sourcing from specific production areas. As of the end of March 2026, it operates 9 stores in the Greater Tokyo area. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,135 million.
entries.400ae4946be7ffa7: A service that operates “Food Talent Bank,” which introduces personnel to food businesses.
entries.4ad6b9e1d1f2b5eb: A service that operates “Food Talent Bank,” which introduces personnel to food businesses. It mainly introduces permanent-employee candidates to restaurants and supermarkets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥336 million.
entries.85b483f91c659edc: A company running a fresh-food distribution platform business, centered on "Uo Pochi," an E-commerce service selling fresh food to restaurants.
entries.9c2399ba0a1042d4: A single-segment business dealing in the distribution of fresh food, consisting of three services: the BtoB commerce service, the BtoC commerce service and the HR service. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,348 million for the BtoB commerce service, ¥1,135 million for the BtoC commerce service and ¥336 million for the HR service, accounting for 81.2%, 14.5% and 4.3% of total revenue, respectively. The consolidated subsidiary Foodison Ota, Inc. acts as a wholesaler at the Ota Market of the Tokyo Central Wholesale Market, handling product sales and purchasing, and the company also holds bidding rights at the Toyosu Market.
entries.abc1b54f9bc99d89: Food businesses such as restaurants and supermarkets
entries.abc222abc5af5b5a: A service that sells food purchased from producers, wholesalers, manufacturers and others by listing it in the web catalog of its own website “Uopochi” and selling directly, mainly to users such as restaurants. It lists 8,000 or more types of products, and ordered products reach stores within 3 days from the next day, depending on the region. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,348 million, and the service operates across 46 prefectures in Japan (excluding Okinawa Prefecture and some remote islands).
